description: Asia Insurance Company Limited is a general insurer that has been publicly listed since 1979, writing property and casualty cover together with Takaful through a window operation. It offers motor, travel, home, agriculture, solar panel and business insurance - the last including fire and allied perils, product liability and weather index cover - and reports serving more than 273,000 group and individual customers. The company states that it is backed by German development bank KfW through its InsuResilience Investment Fund, managed by BlueOrchard Finance, following a Rs. 350 million investment that raised its equity above Rs. 1 billion.
sourceNote: Written from: Asia Insurance Company Limited website (asiainsurance.com.pk: home, about us, business insurance, management, contact) (accessed 2026-10-17)
